label: represents
rationale: Semantic representation/aboutness relation; no separate relator is required in Core.

label: interpretedIn
rationale: Contextual interpretation relation between artifact and situation.

label: hasIdentifier
rationale: Reference/association between representation and identifier artifact.

label: identifiesSubject
rationale: Identification/reference relation, not composition or truth-made by a dedicated relator.

label: assertedBy
rationale: Claim provenance historically depends on an assertion/issuance act by a party; formal OWL may use direct property plus provenance event.

label: supportsClaim
rationale: Evidential support relation; support does not imply truth.

label: derivedFrom
rationale: Derived evidence depends historically on source evidence.

label: groundedBy
rationale: Evidence grounds the relator; separate mediation is not claimed.

label: carriesClaim
rationale: Credential content/support relation; not physical componentOf.

label: credentialIssuedBy
rationale: Credential historically depends on issuing activity/issuer provenance.

label: producesCredential
rationale: Credential comes into managed existence through issuance event.

label: producesAssuranceAssessment
rationale: Assessment artifact results from proofing event.

label: createsDigitalIdentity
rationale: DigitalIdentity may be brought into managed existence by Enrollment.

label: createsBinding
rationale: IdentityBinding may be established by Enrollment.

label: authenticationInContext
rationale: Authentication is situated/interpreted with respect to IdentityContext; native OntoUML encoding may use event-situation linkage.

label: producesAuthenticationResult
rationale: AuthenticationResult artifact depends historically on Authentication event.

label: evaluatesRequest
rationale: AuthorizationRequest participates as input to Authorization event.

label: requestAction
rationale: AuthorizationRequest information-content link to Action specification.

label: producesAuthorizationResult
rationale: Decision/result artifact depends historically on evaluation event.

label: permissionAppliesTo
rationale: Normative scope relation represented by Permission.

label: grantScope
rationale: AccessGrant relator mediates/qualifies Resource scope where reified.

label: assessmentTarget
rationale: AssuranceAssessment refers to/assesses a proofing event; profile-specific targets use qualified variants.

label: trustTarget
rationale: TrustAssessment concerns a target; external ONTrust relation provides deeper trust semantics.

label: trustAlignsTo
rationale: Explicit alignment/reference relation to external trust artifact/concept.

label: reliesOn
rationale: Generic reliance relation; profile may derive it from concrete credential/assertion/authentication interactions.

label: verifiesEvidence
rationale: Generic verification-role relation; concrete verification event semantics belong to specialized profile patterns.
